description: Handle daemon-level meta-commands that short-circuit normal agent dispatch. otto retry: re-trigger a fresh agent run for the same source comment (re-hydrate context, re-claim). otto cancel / otto stop / otto disregard and similar: post a status comment explaining that cancellation is not supported in this version, then mark the task ignored — no agent run, no worktree. These are checked before dispatch, not via a classifier. Neither triggers a run or worktree.
title: otto retry and reserved keyword handling (cancel, stop → clarify)
